# Concept Demo: Chat Protocol and UI Blocks

The contract between the backend (FastAPI + LangGraph) and the frontend (React + TS). All
messages are JSON over one WebSocket per chat.

**Endpoint**: `ws://127.0.0.1:8000/ws/chat/{chat_id}`. `chat_id` is a UUID generated by the
client and stored in localStorage (wrap access in try/catch). A new chat uses a new UUID.

REST helpers:
- `GET /api/health` returns `{status, mode, llm_model, search}`.
- `GET /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages` returns `{messages: ChatMessage[]}`, the history on reload.

## Client → server

```json
{ "type": "user_message", "message_id": "uuid", "text": "Compare Golf GTI Mk8 and i30 N for racing" }
```

## Server → client

```jsonc
// progress while the hub works (may arrive many times per turn)
{ "type": "status", "stage": "understanding|resolving|cache|researching|validating|analyzing|composing|done",
  "text": "Researching Hyundai i30 N (2021–) …", "car": "Hyundai i30 N" /* optional */ }

// final answer of a turn
{ "type": "assistant_message", "message_id": "uuid", "created_at": "ISO-8601",
  "text": "markdown", "blocks": [ /* Block[] */ ] }

// echo of the stored user message (sent after receiving user_message)
{ "type": "user_message_ack", "message_id": "uuid", "created_at": "ISO-8601" }

{ "type": "error", "text": "human readable" }
```

`ChatMessage` (history) is `{ role: "user" | "assistant", message_id, created_at, text, blocks: Block[] }`.

## Shared value types

```ts
type Provenance = "MANUFACTURER_CLAIM" | "MEASURED" | "SOURCED_FACT" | "DERIVED" | "SIMULATED_ESTIMATE" | "ASSUMPTION";
type Confidence = "HIGH" | "MEDIUM" | "LOW";
type SourceRef = { name: string; url: string; type: "MANUFACTURER" | "INSTRUMENTED_TEST" | "PUBLICATION" | "ENCYCLOPEDIA" | "SPEC_DATABASE"; retrieved_at: string; excerpt?: string };
type Car = { id: string; label: string; powertrain: "ICE" | "BEV" | "HEV" | "PHEV" | "MHEV"; from_cache: boolean; researched_at: string };
```

## Blocks

```ts
type Block =
 | { type: "spec_table"; title: string; cars: Car[];
     rows: { key: string; label: string; unit: string | null;
             values: { car_id: string; available: boolean; display: string | null; value: number | string | null;
                       provenance: Provenance | null; confidence: Confidence | null; sources: SourceRef[] }[] }[] }
 | { type: "metric_bars"; title: string;
     metrics: { key: string; label: string; unit: string; better: "higher" | "lower";
                values: { car_id: string; label: string; value: number | null }[] }[] }
 | { type: "race_chart"; title: string; model_version: string;
     settings: { surface: "DRY" | "WET"; extra_load_kg: number; temperature_c: number; altitude_m: number };
     series: { car_id: string; label: string; t: number[]; v_kmh: number[]; s_m: number[] }[];
     results: { car_id: string; label: string; rank: number; t_0_100: number; t_0_200: number | null;
                t_400m: number; v_400m: number; claimed_0_100: number | null }[];
     excluded: { car_id: string; label: string; reason: string }[];
     assumptions: { car_id: string; items: { name: string; value: number | string; unit: string | null }[] }[] }
 | { type: "profile_scores"; title: string; profile: "performance" | "smart_buyer" | "tech";
     criteria: { key: string; label: string; weight: number }[];
     scores: { car_id: string; label: string; total: number /*0–100*/; parts: Record<string, number | null> }[];
     winner_car_id: string | null }
 | { type: "maintenance"; title: string;
     items: { car_id: string; label: string; interval_km: number | null; interval_months: number | null;
              annual_cost_eur: number | null; basis: "SOURCED" | "ASSUMPTION"; notes: string[] }[] }
 | { type: "sources"; title: string; items: SourceRef[] }
 | { type: "notice"; level: "info" | "warning"; text: string };
```

## UI rules

- Each value shows a small **provenance** badge and a **confidence** dot (HIGH green, MEDIUM amber,
  LOW red). Sources open in a popover or tooltip with the name, type, date, excerpt, and link.
- `available: false` renders as "unavailable" (muted), never as an empty cell or 0.
- `race_chart`: an ECharts line chart of speed (km/h) vs time (s), one series per car; a results
  table below it; a label "Simulated estimate · {model_version}"; assumptions listed.
- `profile_scores`: horizontal bars per car (0–100), with the winner highlighted; criteria
  weights shown.
- `maintenance` with basis `ASSUMPTION` shows an "assumption" badge.
- `notice` shows as a colored inline banner.
- Unknown block types are ignored (forward compatibility).
